about: Free Saturday (13 November 2026). Justin: carousels that offer a free resource each week and get followers to leave an email or sign in for the free downloads. One taster a Saturday, in this order, from content/printables/free-tasters.json (live or no-listing only, never a hold). guidedchildhood.com/free/this-week always opens the taster of the most recent Saturday on or before today (London time), so the Instagram bio link and every Story link sticker stay the same week after week. The Saturday engine (Carousels, gc-weekly-promise) builds each week's carousel from the row whose date is that Saturday. 14 November was already booked with The Planet Post (its own page, /free/planet-post) and 21 November is the reserved Paris post, so neither carries a taster and the link opens /free until 28 November. No taster repeats within eight weeks.
